name: spotspeeder
description: A GeckoView WebExtension for TunePacer to adjust Spotify playback rate with BPM-smart features
author: Jacob Lamp

scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && vite build --config vite.config.main.js && vite build --config vite.config.messaging.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "vite build --watch --minify false --config vite.config.main.js" "vite build --watch --minify false --config vite.config.messaging.js"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check
